_about: Curated HanoiGO places. One record per place; python -m app.infrastructure.db.seed upserts them by slug. Prices and hours are estimates unless price_verified / hours_verified is true with a matching *_source link. opening_hours is either a preset name from opening_hour_presets or a {weekday 0=Mon..6=Sun: [[open, close]]} map.
